# build-events.txt -- every `cg_event <id>` line the config generator's
# build may print (base#1467), one id per line. Two readers hold it to
# that: buildgate's TestBuildEventsListEveryEvId requires each id an ev()
# call of this package names, and script/test/config_gen_gates.sh
# re-emits a `cg_event` line from the build log only when its id is listed
# here, so a refusal the build prints always reaches the runner's records.
# Each id must also be registered in dist/script/docker/lib/log-events.txt
# (config_gen_gates_spec.bats checks it).

# The admit RUN of Dockerfile.config-gen and script/test/config_gen_admit.sh
# (base#1465).
config_gen_manifest_missing
config_gen_manifest_stale

# The coverage ratchet, buildgate.Ratchet (base#1465).
config_gen_coverage_fragment_invalid
config_gen_coverage_floors_base_invalid
config_gen_coverage_floors_dir_deleted
config_gen_coverage_floor_duplicate
config_gen_coverage_floor_missing
config_gen_coverage_floor_orphan
config_gen_coverage_floor_below
config_gen_coverage_floor_too_low
config_gen_coverage_floor_lowered
config_gen_coverage_floor_stale
config_gen_coverage_floor_none_misuse
config_gen_coverage_floor_dropped

# The ignored-input, corpus sensitivity and mutation gates (base#1467).
config_gen_mutation_ignored_input
config_gen_corpus_sensitivity_weak
config_gen_corpus_sensitivity_invalid
config_gen_mutation_manifest_invalid
config_gen_mutation_no_such_package
config_gen_mutation_unmapped
